cornerstone.full_quote: Each Cornerstone Investor has agreed that without the prior written consent of our Company, the Joint Sponsors and the Overall Coordinators, it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months following the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares it has purchased, pursuant to the respective Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries who will be bound by the same obligations of the Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from the Listing Date; document wording 'six months following the Listing Date' - restricted period deemed inclusive of Listing Date per convention
cornerstone.notes: Wording is 'six months following the Listing Date' (not 'from and inclusive of').

controller_6m.notes: No controlling-shareholder lock-up disclosed. 9981 is an A+H issuer (PRC issuer under Rule 19A; A Shares already listed in Shenzhen). The Underwriting section contains only the Rule 10.08 undertaking by the Company and Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement undertakings by the Company (pages 283-284); '10.07' appears nowhere except as a percentage figure on page 124. 'Controlling Shareholder' occurs only in the Articles-of-Association appendix and financial statements (pages 400, 401, 415). The single largest shareholder (Mr. Zhou, page 122) gives no disposal or control lock-up.
